If this repeats, your device camera may be in use by another app, or blocked by the system.

Check:
① Is cc-haha running on the computer?
② Is the address correct? (LAN: same Wi-Fi; remote: public URL or tunnel)
③ Is H5 Access still enabled?

How to get the address:
1. Open cc-haha desktop app on your computer
2. Settings → H5 Access → enable “Enable H5 access”
3. Tap “Generate token” — a QR code appears on screen
4. Tap “Scan QR” below to scan it, or tap “Copy launch URL” and paste it above

Tap an address to connect; long-press to rename or delete.
Note: phone and computer must be on the same Wi-Fi. The link contains a token — treat it like a password.
